data.summary: This facet result summarises 2 fields from 90 of 100 records, with 2 overlays; 1 of 2 inferential findings show evidence at their alpha.
caveats: 2 p-values here carry no adjustment for multiple comparisons, so some may fall below alpha by chance alone; this is the concern the PULSE_ADVISORY_MANY_TESTS advisory raises.
Adding a multiplicity block (for example holm) adjusts them for multiple comparisons; then read p_adjusted beside each raw p-value.
OVERLAY_KS_VS_POP carries no alpha of its own unless it is adjusted, so its p-values are read here against 0.05.
OVERLAY_CHISQ_VS_POP carries no alpha of its own unless it is adjusted, so its p-values are read here against 0.05.
The facet request is absent, so an overlay is not tied to the field it decorates; pass it beside the result to read each overlay with its field.
